kind: bounded tracing/time host diagnostic; corrected unsupported FTLE and particle timing semantics
candidate: mask-aware compact cell-BVH candidate identified by source_sha256
retained (probe expectation flag for corrected FTLE/timing)
features.allocations: separate feature enables global allocator instrumentation

methodology: Identical release probe source at 4/6/8 cubed grids. Four allocator-disabled processes/version, ABBA twice with alternating case order, warmup/five samples per case; separate allocation runs. Streamlines use 16 seeds/12 steps, particles 16 seeds/eight frames/trail four, LIC two kernel steps, FTLE two RK2 steps. Input validation and compact cell-BVH construction added in candidate are included on every call. Outputs are checked outside timing; destruction excluded. Uniform flow analytic checks cover path positions and FTLE zero on supported interior points. Baseline FTLE falsely labels unsupported boundaries zero/valid; candidate masks them, so finite valid sample counts differ. Each run also reproduces the old linear-time pathline phase error and premature streak release advance, with explicit baseline/candidate expectations. All fixtures stay below parallel worker thresholds. No controlled affinity/thermal/energy, peak RSS, application frame or physical mobile acceptance claim. BVH footprint consists of original cell indices plus tree nodes, with leaf-local stencil enumeration and no retained tetrahedron array. Highly overlapping cells can still require linear traversal.
